source.scope: Published numeric inputs and assertions only. No package installed and no reference library code executed or copied.

conventions.referenceSiderealTime: mean; Meeus polynomial in the source
conventions.referenceObliquityModel: fixed default, not date-dependent true obliquity
conventions.utcDerivation: UTC hours are explicitly asserted in tests/Origin.test.js, not inferred from city names. Source month 6 means July.
conventions.toleranceRationale: Chosen before comparing: 0.36 arcseconds is twice the four-decimal-degree rounding half-step. The 60 arcsecond date-based threshold is a coarse discrepancy screen allowing different sidereal/obliquity conventions for these two non-polar 2019 cases, not a validated error bound or product accuracy claim. Whole Sign cusps must agree exactly.
